# CLI: Compute

## create-server

Kind: Write.

Checks inventory and price before placing one order. Supply an SSH key or
`--user-data-file` for cloud-init login. Floating IP attachment is unavailable.

| Flag                             | Type       | Required |
| -------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- |
| `--name`                         | `string`   | yes      |
| `--zone-id`                      | `string`   | yes      |
| `--flavor-id`                    | `string`   | yes      |
| `--image-id`                     | `string`   | yes      |
| `--vpc-id`                       | `string`   | yes      |
| `--subnet-id`                    | `string`   | yes      |
| `--security-group-id`            | `[]string` | yes      |
| `--ssh-key-id`                   | `string`   |          |
| `--root-disk-size`               | `int`      | yes      |
| `--root-disk-type-id`            | `string`   | yes      |
| `--root-disk-encryption-type-id` | `string`   |          |
| `--data-disk-size`               | `int`      |          |
| `--data-disk-type-id`            | `string`   |          |
| `--data-disk-name`               | `string`   |          |
| `--data-disk-encryption-type-id` | `string`   |          |
| `--server-group-id`              | `string`   |          |
| `--auto-renew`                   | `bool`     |          |
| `--attach-floating-ip`           | `bool`     |          |
| `--allow-open-login`             | `bool`     |          |
| `--max-price`                    | `float64`  |          |
| `--no-wait`                      | `bool`     |          |
| `--user-data-file`               | `string`   |          |

```sh
greennode compute create-server --name <name> --zone-id <zone-id> --flavor-id <flavor-id> --image-id <image-id> --vpc-id <vpc-id> --subnet-id <subnet-id> --security-group-id <security-group-id> --root-disk-size <root-disk-size> --root-disk-type-id <root-disk-type-id>
```

## create-server-group

Kind: Write.

Creates a group with a placement policy. Inspect `list-server-groups` after an
unconfirmed create.

| Flag            | Type     | Required |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--name`        | `string` | yes      |
| `--policy-id`   | `string` | yes      |
| `--description` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode compute create-server-group --name <name> --policy-id <policy-id>
```

## delete-server

Kind: Write, destructive.

The boot volume is always deleted. Data volumes are retained unless
`--delete-volumes` is set.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id`      | `string` | yes      |
| `--delete-volumes` | `bool`   |          |
| `--no-wait`        | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode compute delete-server --server-id <server-id> --yes
```

## delete-server-group

Kind: Write, destructive.

Checks group membership before requesting deletion.

| Flag                | Type     | Required |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-group-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh

```

## get-server

Kind: Read.

PublicIP is the canonical floating address derived from internal interfaces.
Conflicting, invalid, private, or absent addresses leave it empty.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode compute get-server --server-id <server-id>
```

## get-server-console-log

Kind: Read.

Console logs can hold passwords and keys. Text output writes the log without an
added newline. Terminals escape controls other than newline and tab. A query
that returns a string uses the same text rules.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode compute get-server-console-log --server-id <server-id>
```

## list-flavor-prices

Kind: Read.

Quotes price only the instance component of a reference server. Use
`--root-disk-type-id` to select a catalog disk type. The default uses a 3000
IOPS disk.

Without `--zone-id`, disabled zones retain catalog rows without quotes. Select a
disabled zone explicitly to quote its rows.

Memory bounds and `--sort-by ram` use the raw catalog units. `--allow-partial`
retains results if discovery is incomplete.

| Flag                   | Type     | Required |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--zone-id`            | `string` |          |
| `--root-disk-type-id`  | `string` |          |
| `--family`             | `string` |          |
| `--platform`           | `string` |          |
| `--name`               | `string` |          |
| `--min-ram`            | `int64`  |          |
| `--max-ram`            | `int64`  |          |
| `--include-non-public` | `bool`   |          |
| `--available-only`     | `bool`   |          |
| `--max-requests`       | `int`    |          |
| `--allow-partial`      | `bool`   |          |
| `--descending`         | `bool`   |          |
| `--sort-by`            | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode compute list-flavor-prices
```

## reboot-server

Kind: Write, destructive.

Reboots an active server. Inspect `get-server` and the console after an
unconfirmed reboot.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode compute reboot-server --server-id <server-id> --yes
```

## resize-server

Kind: Write, destructive.

Changes the flavor of an active or stopped server. The signed quote can be a
credit. Inspect `get-server` after an unconfirmed resize.

| Flag          | Type      | Required |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string`  | yes      |
| `--flavor-id` | `string`  | yes      |
| `--max-price` | `float64` |          |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode compute resize-server --server-id <server-id> --flavor-id <flavor-id> --yes
```

## start-server

Kind: Write.

Starts a stopped server. An active server returns with `Changed` set to false.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode compute start-server --server-id <server-id>
```

## stop-server

Kind: Write, destructive.

Stops an active server. A stopped server returns with `Changed` set to false.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode compute stop-server --server-id <server-id> --yes
```
